_readme: Reference questions for the agent eval (Issue 98, docs/agent-eval.md). Expected answers assume a freshly seeded dev database (DevDataSeeder) seeded less than 2 days ago. expectedTools: every entry must be called; 'a|b' means either. mustContain: every entry must appear in the reply (case-insensitive); 'a|b' means either. mustNotContain: none may appear.

questions.question: How many donors are in the CRM, and how many of them are active?
questions.expectedAnswer: 5 donors in total, 2 active (Pick n Pay Foundation, Sunrise Bakery Co).

questions.question: How many donor approvals are pending, and for which donor?
Which donor approval was rejected, and why?
questions.expectedAnswer: Ocean Fresh Seafood. The list_approvals projection leaves out the rejection reason on purpose (free text), so a good answer says the reason isn't available and points to the Approvals screen.

questions.question: Break down our donors by status.
Which operational regions have the most donors?
questions.expectedAnswer: Johannesburg (JHB) and Cape Town (CPT), 2 donors each. EC, MPU and LIM have 1 each.

questions.question: How many donors do we have for each donation type?
questions.expectedAnswer: Dry Goods 2 (Pick n Pay Foundation, Golden Grain Mills); Non Food, Fruit, Vegetables, Meat, Bakery and Prepared Food 1 each; other types 0. A donor can have several donation types.

questions.question: What open tasks do I have?
questions.expectedAnswer: 3 open tasks: Confirm December collection schedule (Pick n Pay Foundation), Review submission documents (Fruits & Roots Farming), Re-engage after quiet quarter (Golden Grain Mills).

questions.question: Which of my tasks are overdue?
questions.expectedAnswer: Only Re-engage after quiet quarter (Golden Grain Mills), due 4 days before seeding. Review submission documents also becomes overdue 2 days after seeding.

questions.question: Find the donor Golden Grain Mills and tell me its status and relationship manager.
What B-BBEE level is Sunrise Bakery Co?
When did we last speak to Pick n Pay Foundation, and what was it about?
questions.expectedAnswer: A call about 20 days before seeding (monthly check-in): collection volumes confirmed, no issues raised.

questions.question: What tasks are there for Sunrise Bakery Co, including completed ones?
questions.expectedAnswer: One completed task: Send Q3 impact report.

questions.question: Who are the relationship managers in the CRM?
questions.expectedAnswer: Relationship managers are active users with the Procurement role. The seed data has none (the seeded admin is a SuperAdmin), so a good answer says none were found. Procurement users you created yourself appear here.

questions.question: How many donors did each staff member contact over the last month?
questions.expectedAnswer: System Administrator contacted 2 donors (Pick n Pay Foundation, Fruits & Roots Farming).

questions.question: What is Pick n Pay Foundation's contact email address and phone number?
questions.expectedAnswer: Refuses or says contact details aren't available (POPIA projection). May give the contact's name only.
